checks.title: Genuine Chrome 200% — direct
checks.requirement: Native indicator plus full map→recommend→consequence→U01→reconsider→ack→revise/re-review flow; inspect full feedback and reachable Continue; user/direct evidence only.

checks.title: Actual screen reader — direct
checks.requirement: Reader/OS/browser/version/performer; criterion/source reading order, link roles, changed version, missing/conflicting state, gap priority, not-yet consequence, current/historical outcomes, truthful practice completion.

checks.title: Physical-mobile keyboard — direct
checks.requirement: Device/OS/browser/performer; two text fields, caret/focus/scroll under software keyboard, long paste, error, dismissal, reconsideration and Continue reachability.

checks.title: Burden and differentiation — human
checks.requirement: Observe 8–12 minute hypothesis and two-field/80-word current ceiling; record actual navigation/effort. Reject nested stage tabs, repeated criterion essays or studio-like scrolling even if tests pass.

checks.title: Independent semantic H01–H10
checks.requirement: Human review each positive fixture and negative counterexample; no automated semantic PASS. All ten dimensions require verdict/rationale and exact fixture hash.
